Graduate Admission Requirements
Application Processing Fee
Currently, the graduate application fee for domestic applicants is $20.00 and $30.00 for international applicants. After completing your application, you will see instructions to pay the fee with a credit or debit card via a secure payment portal. An application processing fee is charged for each application submission. The application fee is non-refundable once the application has been submitted.
Application fee waivers and/or discounts may be available. Please contact [email protected] for more information.
To be considered for admissions to the Graduate School, applicants must meet the following admissions requirements:
Minimum Academic Credentials
Bachelor's degree from a U.S. institution accredited at the institutional level by a USDOE accreditor OR equivalent from a recognized institution of higher learning abroad.
Applicants enrolled in the final year of a bachelor's degree or international equivalent will be considered for conditional admission.
All transcripts for universities outside of the U.S. must be evaluated by a NACES Evaluation Agency.
Minimum GPA Requirements
2.5 overall grade point average (GPA) on a 4.0 scale for a bachelor's degree, OR
2.75 overall grade point average (GPA) on a 4.0 scale on the last 60 hours of undergraduate coursework, OR
3.0 overall grade point average (GPA) on a 4.0 point scale on at least nine hours of graduate coursework.
Note: some programs may require a separate GPA requirement. Please check the individual program webpages for more information.
Minimum Transcript Requirements
Applicants must submit transcripts from all four year universities or colleges where they earned a Bachelors and Masters degree (if applicable).
Unofficial transcripts are acceptable for conditional admissions decisions and can be uploaded with application.
Official transcripts will be required if student is admitted; student must request transcripts be sent to the Office of Admissions before the end of the first semester that they are enrolled.
Entrance Exam Requirements
GRE and GMAT are no longer required for most programs.
Please check the individual program webpages for more information.
Graduate Record Exam (GRE)
The institution code for reporting GRE scores to LSU New Orleans: 6379
Where required, GRE scores are accepted only for:
Tests taken within 5 years of the entrance term.
Official scores - those reported electronically to LSU New Orleans by ETS.
Graduate Management Admissions Test (GMAT)
Programs in the Henry Bernstein College of Business Administration that may require GMAT scores are accepted only for:
Tests taken within 5 years of the entrance term.
Official scores - those reported electronically to LSU New Orleans by GMAC
Additional Department Requirements
Many of our programs also require additional items such as a Statement of Purpose, Letters of Recommendation, etc.
Please check our Graduate Degree webpage for more information.
International Graduate Admissions Requirements
International applicants must meet the criteria above for admissions as well as additional steps. Please be sure to review the additional requirements at the webpage below:
International Admissions Requirements
